correctness.rationale: For n even, a fixed full-step Q2R state has neither sublattice flipping. The four directed neighbors in the two-row periodic quotient give exact local counts a_r+c_r+2b_(1-r), and the displayed 16-state transfer bijects labeled frozen patterns with its closed walks, weighting all 4n bonds exactly once. Exact symbolic characteristic-polynomial identity was recomputed from the transfer construction; the reciprocal determinant yields the full polynomial for every even n>=4. The unweighted Lucas expression follows from all sixteen roots, and the checkerboard gauge involution exchanges every aligned and misaligned bond. A separately implemented C++ phase-by-phase exhaustive simulator and symbolic transfer program were replayed and agreed through the selected boundaries. Only the exact bijection, determinant certificate, and involution establish the infinite statement; finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: An energy-conserving reversible model has nontrivial frozen-state sectors whose entire microcanonical weight distribution is otherwise unspecified by conservation. The proven exact all-circumference energy polynomial computes a natural, dynamical invariant; its golden-ratio entropy per spin and exact bond-energy mirror symmetry give substantive structural information and make the smallest globally checkerboard-periodic torus a reproducible benchmark for studying constrained freezing. The quantitative answer is not a bounded census, arbitrary parameter slice, or simple restatement of bipartite gauge symmetry: the nontrivial sixteen-state characteristic identity determines all energy coefficients.
